command: cooperbench run -n solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash_10-r2 -s flash_10 -a mini_swe_agent_v2 -m gemini/gemini-3.8-flash --agent-config configs/gemini_3_8_flash_high.yaml --setting solo -c 10 --backend docker
agent_config:
# Shared CooperBench agent config override for runs on Gemini 3.8 Flash.
# Pass via: --agent-config configs/gemini_3_8_flash_high.yaml
# Deep-merged onto coop.yaml (multi-agent) or solo.yaml (single-agent) by MiniSweAgentV2Runner.
agent:
  cost_limit: 10.0

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: high
      includeThoughts: true
